# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 8
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 11-14 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 8

---

[Pages 11-14 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 8 falls entirely within this second lacuna. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The text resumes at the bottom of page 14, mid-narrative, with the soul's encounter with Desire already underway.]

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* All three agents agree: no translation is possible for the missing pages. The second lacuna (pages 11-14) removes the beginning of Mary's visionary account — the soul's ascent through the cosmic powers. What survives beginning in chapter 9 is the tail end of the Desire encounter. The lost material likely contained the soul's encounters with the first and second powers. This is one of the most significant textual losses in the Gospel of Mary, as it would have contained the core of the Savior's private revelation to Mary.
